snippet.title: Z.A.T.O. Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
USSR, 1986. A girl goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, yet not a soul seems to be concerned. Uncover the mystery behind her disappearance and transmit your signal to the universe. 

***
Z.A.T.O. is a free mystery visual novel. Releases for Windows, Mac and Linux on November 11, 2025 on Steam and Itch. 

Wishlist Z.A.T.O. on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4122860/ZATO__I_Love_the_World_and_Everything_In_It/
